items.prompt: The warehouse serves three segments. It requires flexible layouts. → ___ three segments, the warehouse requires flexible layouts.
The team reviewed throughput data. They found a bottleneck. → ___ throughput data, the team found a bottleneck.
items.hintAfterError: Ação que aconteceu antes da outra: "having" + particípio (ou só o -ing).

items.prompt: Czarnikow invested in automation. It improved accuracy by 30%. → ___ in automation, Czarnikow improved accuracy by 30%.
The facility was designed for speed. It struggles with complex orders. → ___ for speed, the facility struggles with complex orders.
items.hintAfterError: A primeira frase está na voz passiva: a oração reduzida usa só o particípio.

items.prompt: We analysed unit economics. We discovered hidden losses. → ___ unit economics, we discovered hidden losses.
The manager considered flexibility. She redesigned the picking zones. → ___ flexibility, the manager redesigned the picking zones.
The warehouse operates 24 hours. It serves both domestic and export clients. → ___ 24 hours, the warehouse serves both domestic and export clients.
They expanded real estate. They gained capacity for peak seasons. → ___ real estate, they gained capacity for peak seasons.
The company balanced speed and accuracy. It achieved the best service score. → ___ speed and accuracy, the company achieved the best service score.
The team measured downstream impact. They adjusted the service offer. → ___ downstream impact, the team adjusted the service offer.
